assumptions.precision: float32 (1,536 bytes/vector) with scalar quantization option to int8
assumptions.managed_db_reference: Pinecone Standard Pod (s1/p1 instances) and Serverless compute

comparison_table.qdrant_hardware: Embedded on application server or AWS t4g.small (2GB RAM, 2 vCPU)
comparison_table.notes: At 100K vectors, a managed DB charges a heavy fixed pod tax for idle time. Embedded Qdrant runs inside app process for $0 incremental cost.

comparison_table.qdrant_hardware: Dedicated VPS / AWS t4g.medium (4GB RAM, 20GB NVMe SSD)
comparison_table.managed_db_tier: Pinecone Standard (1-2 pods with high-availability replication)
comparison_table.notes: Qdrant uses memory-mapped (mmap) storage on NVMe SSD, keeping active vectors hot in cache without requiring all vectors in expensive RAM.

comparison_table.qdrant_hardware: Cloud instance e.g. AWS c6g.xlarge / Hetzner AX41 (16GB RAM, 64GB NVMe)
comparison_table.managed_db_tier: Pinecone 4x-8x pod cluster (s1/p1 tiers for 10M 384-dim vectors)
comparison_table.notes: Enabling Qdrant's Scalar Quantization (SQ) reduces RAM footprint by 75% with <1% recall degradation, avoiding massive cloud pod bills.
